# Geometry Wars 2 PC Plus 1.2.0

This is an unofficial fan-made port, not affiliated with or endorsed by the game's makers or publishers, and **no game files are included**: you need your own Xbox Live Arcade package.

## New: your pilot

Open **Pilot**, in the panel left of the main menu. It follows you across every mode, and your existing bests count from the first launch, so veterans start ranked and levelled.

- **Levels.** XP comes mostly from time survived, with big bonuses for a new best, a new tier or a finished bounty. Your level never goes down, and the results screen shows what each run earned.
- **Mastery tiers.** Every board has its own Bronze, Silver, Gold, Neon and Master, set by your best score. The badges appear on the Single Player tiles and beside each player on the game's leaderboards.
- **Bounties.** Three open goals, such as a score, a survival time or a kill count in a particular mode. They never expire, swapping one is free, and finishing one draws another.
- **24 rewards.** Moving interface palettes (Synthwave, Aurora, Plasma), crosshairs (Diamond, Reticle, Starburst, Halo), 14 titles from Rookie to Black Hole Gourmet, and ship colours (Hot Pink, Gold, Ice). Each one says how it's earned. They're all cosmetic, and every colour you already had stays free.
- **Stats.** Each board's tier and best, the score to the next tier, runs, geoms and time per mode, and lifetime totals: enemies, black holes, gates, geoms collected and more.

Progress is kept on your own PC in `user_data/progression.toml`. Your level isn't shown online; the leaderboard badges come from the score on the board. Custom modes earn XP too: full XP for time survived, and 250 for a new best in the mode or a practice level. Replays earn nothing.

## Also new

- **Hide the results screen if you like.** Press **LB**, **1** or **F5** on it to hide or show it. Your choice is remembered, so you only press it once.
- **Geoms collected** on the results screen.
- **The game's tile grid** behind the overlay panels: Pilot, Watch replays, Custom modes, the results screen and the main menu tiles.
- **Brackets in the game's lettering**, so a mode called "Master Deadline (custom)" reads properly.

## Good to know

- A run you quit from the pause menu counts when your next round starts, not straight away.

## Installing

1. Download **GeometryWarsRetroEvolved2-v1.2.0-windows-x64.zip**, extract it anywhere you can write to, and run `geometry_wars_retro_evolved_2.exe`. Updating: extract over your current folder, or use the launcher's update.
2. On the **Play** page click **Install from package...** and pick your Geometry Wars: Retro Evolved 2 package (Title ID `584108FF`, game version 0.0.1.2).
3. Press **PLAY**.

Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit), a DirectX 12 graphics card and the latest Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 Redistributable (x64) are needed. The build is not digitally signed, so SmartScreen may warn: choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
